content:
Apple 推出 a new version of the Apple Invites app for iPhone today. The update takes full advantage of new features in iOS 27, including enhanced photo sharing and Image Playground capabilities.

Below are the full release notes Apple issued today for the Apple Invites update:

  • Shared albums now support full-resolution sharing, so you can relive every detail within the app. Anyone can join and contribute, including users without Apple devices.
  • Image Playground can now create high-quality backgrounds in nearly any style, including photorealistic, so your invitations can perfectly capture the mood you envision.
  • Guests who require email verification can now tap a link in their inbox instead of entering a verification code, making it easier to join an event.
  • This update includes bug fixes and performance improvements.

You can download Apple Invites from the App Store. The app requires an iCloud+ subscription to create invitations, but anyone can RSVP.
